title: Injected dependency left to the container and a scope created in a hosted service

consumerGuidance.architecture: Worker Service. IReconciliationJob is registered scoped; ILogger and IServiceScopeFactory are container-owned singletons. BackgroundService is the composition root for each iteration.
consumerGuidance.notes: The worker is a singleton, which is why it resolves the scoped job per iteration rather than injecting it.

forbiddenFindings.example: Requiring the worker to dispose the injected IServiceScopeFactory or ILogger.
Reporting the scope factory as a service-locator anti-pattern; a hosted service is a legitimate composition root.
Requiring a job scheduler library, mediator or channel-based pipeline instead.
Objecting to await using versus using, or to the loop shape.

notes: Pairs with di-captive-dependency-and-shared-cache and disposal-and-escaping-scope: the correct resolution of the same lifetime problem must not be reported as a defect.
